scope_constraints.applies_to: End-to-end hybrid receiver combining mod-2 CNOT compression, Pauli-X sign-flip rectification, 2-adic Newton-Hensel decoupling, and adaptive R_Z(-phi_known) phase feedforward

scope_constraints.does_not_claim: Polynomial-time compilation of the dyadic scale ladder 2^{t-2-r} * U without sufficient pool collisions or trapdoor structure
